mapper.select: SELECT MARKET FROM MARKET_MASTER ORDER BY MARKET

SELECT u.USERID, u.USERNAME, a.MARKET FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR u INNER JOIN HDOC_MARKET_AUTH a ON u.USERID = a.USERID WHERE u.USERID IN (SELECT USERID FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR WHERE USER = #{user}) AND a.MARKET = #{market}

SELECT DISTINCT u.USERID, u.USERNAME, a.MARKET FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR u INNER JOIN HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH f ON u.USERID = f.USERID AND f.`FUNCTION` = 'Rule Admin' INNER JOIN HDOC_MARKET_AUTH a ON u.USERID = a.USERID
a.MARKET = #{market}

SELECT DISTINCT u.USERID, u.USERNAME, a.MARKET FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR u INNER JOIN HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH f ON u.USERID = f.USERID AND f.`FUNCTION` = 'Template Admin' INNER JOIN HDOC_MARKET_AUTH a ON u.USERID = a.USERID
a.MARKET = #{market}
